players.product: UPS systems, switchgear, busway and rack PDUs

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Paulo Ruiz: although data centers get most of the attention, 'the biggest segment we have today is still commercial and institutional', served through Eaton's large traditional distribution network - 'a perpetual growth market' not very susceptible to the cycle - and Eaton is also very strong in utilities. On capacity, after catching up with its 24 facility expansions, Eaton will not run so many projects at once: 'we might have another project launch next year, but we should not expect the company to be running 20 projects in parallel.'
quarterly_data.figure: commercial and institutional still the biggest segment; possibly another facility project next year, not 20 projects in parallel
